// ─── HERO CANVAS ───
function startHeroCanvas(){
const canvas=document.getElementById('hero-canvas'), ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
let w,h;
function resize(){w=canvas.width=canvas.offsetWidth;h=canvas.height=canvas.offsetHeight;}
resize(); window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
const strokes=[];
for(let i=0;i<60;i++) strokes.push({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),len:30+Math.random()*180,angle:-.15+Math.random()*.3,opacity:.02+Math.random()*.08,width:.5+Math.random()*2.5,progress:0,speed:.003+Math.random()*.006,delay:Math.random()*200});
const particles=[];
for(let i=0;i<120;i++) particles.push({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.0003,vy:-.0002-Math.random()*.0004,r:.5+Math.random()*2,opacity:.1+Math.random()*.3,life:Math.random()});
let frame=0;
function draw(){
ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,5,5,0.04)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
strokes.forEach(s=>{
if(frame<s.delay)return; if(s.progress<1)s.progress=Math.min(1,s.progress+s.speed);
const sx=s.x*w,sy=s.y*h,ex=sx+Math.cos(s.angle)*s.len*s.progress,ey=sy+Math.sin(s.angle+.1)*s.len*.3*s.progress;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(sx,sy);ctx.lineTo(ex,ey);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(180,165,145,${s.opacity})`;ctx.lineWidth=s.width;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.stroke();
if(s.progress>.8&&Math.random()>.7){const px=ex+(Math.random()-.5)*8,py=ey+(Math.random()-.5)*4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,Math.random()*1.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(160,145,120,${Math.random()*.06})`;ctx.fill();}
});
particles.forEach(p=>{
p.life+=.003; if(p.life>1){p.life=0;p.x=Math.random();p.y=.8+Math.random()*.2;}
p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy; const fade=Math.sin(p.life*Math.PI);
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x*w,p.y*h,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(140,125,100,${p.opacity*fade*.4})`;ctx.fill();
});
frame++; requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
draw();
}

// ─── PAGE SYSTEM ───
function showPage(name){
document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
const el=document.getElementById('page-'+name);
if(el){el.classList.add('active');window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});}
if(name==='gallery')buildGallery();
if(name==='prints')buildPrints();
setTimeout(()=>observeFadeIns(),100);
}

// ─── FADE OBSERVER ───
const fadeObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('visible');});},{threshold:.1});
function observeFadeIns(){document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in:not(.visible)').forEach(el=>fadeObserver.observe(el));}
observeFadeIns();

// ─── GALLERY ───
function buildGallery(){
const grid=document.getElementById('gallery-grid');
if(grid.children.length>0)return;
grid.innerHTML=artworks.map(a=>`

<img src="${IMGS[a.key]}" alt="${a.title} — Charcoal by Diaan Venter" loading="lazy">
${!a.forSale?'<div class="gallery-item-tag gallery-ref-tag">Reference</div>':''}
<div class="gallery-item-info">
<div class="gallery-item-title">${a.title}</div>
<div class="gallery-item-meta">${a.medium} · ${a.date}</div>
</div>
<div style="position:absolute;top:1rem;right:1rem;z-index:3;width:28px;height:28px;border:1px solid rgba(184,150,62,.4);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:.75rem;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s" class="expand-icon">⊕</div>
</div>
`).join('');
grid.querySelectorAll('.gallery-item').forEach(el=>{
el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{const ic=el.querySelector('.expand-icon');if(ic)ic.style.opacity='1';});
el.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{const ic=el.querySelector('.expand-icon');if(ic)ic.style.opacity='0';});
});
}

// ─── PRINTS ───
const selectedSizes={};
function buildPrints(){
const grid=document.getElementById('prints-grid');
if(grid.children.length>0)return;

<div class="print-price-row">
<div class="print-price" id="price-${p.id}"><span>ZAR </span>R${p.prices[p.sizes[0]]}</div>

}
function selectSize(printId,size,btn){
selectedSizes[printId]=size;
document.querySelectorAll(`#sizes-${printId} .size-btn`).forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
btn.classList.add('active');
const p=prints.find(x=>x.id===printId);
document.getElementById('price-'+printId).innerHTML=`<span>ZAR </span>R${p.prices[size]}`;
}
function addToCart(printId){
const p=prints.find(x=>x.id===printId); const size=selectedSizes[printId]; const price=p.prices[size];
const existing=db.cart.find(x=>x.id===printId&&x.size===size);
if(existing)existing.qty++; else db.cart.push({id:printId,key:p.key,title:p.title,size,price,qty:1});
db.save(); updateCartUI(); showToast(`${p.title} (${size}) added to cart`);
}
function updateCartUI(){
const total=db.cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.qty,0);
const countEl=document.getElementById('cart-count');
countEl.textContent=total; countEl.classList.toggle('visible',total>0);
const itemsEl=document.getElementById('cart-items'),emptyEl=document.getElementById('cart-empty'),footerEl=document.getElementById('cart-footer');
if(db.cart.length===0){emptyEl.style.display='block';footerEl.style.display='none';itemsEl.innerHTML='';itemsEl.appendChild(emptyEl);return;}
emptyEl.style.display='none';footerEl.style.display='block';
const totalAmt=db.cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.price*i.qty),0);
document.getElementById('cart-total-amount').textContent=`R${totalAmt}`;
itemsEl.innerHTML=db.cart.map(item=>`
<div class="cart-item">
<div class="cart-item-thumb"><img src="${IMGS[item.key]}" alt="${item.title}"></div>
<div class="cart-item-details">
<div class="cart-item-name">${item.title}</div>
<div class="cart-item-size">${item.size} · Qty ${item.qty}</div>
<div class="cart-item-price">R${item.price*item.qty}</div>
</div>
<button class="cart-item-remove" onclick="removeFromCart('${item.id}','${item.size}')">✕</button>
</div>`).join('');
}
function removeFromCart(id,size){db.cart=db.cart.filter(x=>!(x.id===id&&x.size===size));db.save();updateCartUI();}
function toggleCart(){document.getElementById('cart-panel').classList.toggle('open');}
function checkout(){
const orderNum='DV-'+Date.now().toString().slice(-6);
db.orders.push({id:orderNum,type:'Print',items:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(db.cart)),date:new Date().toISOString(),status:'Pending'});
db.cart=[];db.save();updateCartUI();document.getElementById('cart-panel').classList.remove('open');showToast(`Order ${orderNum} placed!`);
}
updateCartUI();

// ─── COMMISSION ───
function handleUpload(input){document.getElementById('upload-status').textContent=`${input.files.length} file(s) selected`;}
function submitCommission(){
const name=document.getElementById('c-name').value.trim(),email=document.getElementById('c-email').value.trim();
if(!name||!email){showToast('Please enter your name and email.');return;}
const ref='COMM-'+Date.now().toString().slice(-6);
db.commissions.push({ref,name,email,country:document.getElementById('c-country').value,size:document.getElementById('c-size').value,subjects:document.getElementById('c-subjects').value,budget:document.getElementById('c-budget').value,deadline:document.getElementById('c-deadline').value,notes:document.getElementById('c-notes').value,date:new Date().toISOString(),status:'Pending Review'});
db.save();document.getElementById('comm-success').classList.add('show');showToast(`Commission ${ref} submitted.`);
}

// ─── CONTACT ───
function submitContact(){
if(!document.getElementById('ct-name').value.trim()||!document.getElementById('ct-email').value.trim()){showToast('Please fill in your name and email.');return;}
document.getElementById('contact-success').classList.add('show');showToast('Message sent.');
}

// ─── ADMIN ───
function openAdmin(){document.getElementById('admin').classList.add('active');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';}
function closeAdmin(){document.getElementById('admin').classList.remove('active');document.body.style.overflow='';}
function adminLogin(){
if(document.getElementById('admin-email').value==='diaan1venter@gmail.com'&&document.getElementById('admin-pass').value==='diaan2025'){
document.getElementById('admin-login').style.display='none';
const dash=document.getElementById('admin-dashboard');dash.style.display='flex';dash.style.flexDirection='row';dash.style.width='100%';dash.style.minHeight='100vh';
loadDashboard();
} else {document.getElementById('login-error').style.display='block';}
}
function loadDashboard(){
const totalRevenue=db.orders.reduce((s,o)=>s+(o.items||[]).reduce((ss,i)=>ss+(i.price*i.qty),0),0);
const totalPrints=db.orders.reduce((s,o)=>s+(o.items||[]).reduce((ss,i)=>ss+i.qty,0),0);
document.getElementById('m-orders').textContent=db.orders.length;
document.getElementById('m-prints').textContent=totalPrints;
document.getElementById('m-commissions').textContent=db.commissions.length;
document.getElementById('m-revenue').textContent='R'+totalRevenue;
const tbody=document.getElementById('orders-tbody');
tbody.innerHTML=db.orders.length===0?'<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;color:var(--grey-dark);font-style:italic;padding:2rem">No orders yet</td></tr>':db.orders.slice().reverse().map(o=>`<tr><td>${o.id}</td><td>Print</td><td>${(o.items||[]).map(i=>i.title+' '+i.size).join(', ')}</td><td>R${(o.items||[]).reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.price*i.qty),0)}</td><td><span class="order-status status-pending">${o.status}</span></td></tr>`).join('');
const ctbody=document.getElementById('commissions-tbody');
ctbody.innerHTML=db.commissions.length===0?'<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--grey-dark);font-style:italic;padding:2rem">No commissions yet</td></tr>':db.commissions.slice().reverse().map(c=>`<tr><td>${c.ref}</td><td>${c.name}</td><td>${c.country||'—'}</td><td>${c.subjects||'—'}</td><td>${c.budget||'—'}</td><td><span class="order-status status-pending">${c.status}</span></td></tr>`).join('');
}
